title: LA Colossal – Maki-e 06 (Seated)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Filipino woman in her late 40s, silver-streaked black bob, natural face with a gentle smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the bench, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body maki-e lacquer body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. Deep glossy black urushi with fine sprinkled gold dust forming wisteria clusters and butterflies, crisp raised gold relief. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated upright on a low wooden bench, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee with elbows relaxed out. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch black lacquer platform stiletto sandals with gold ribbon laces tied in a bow below the knee.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, lavender with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: Japanese garden with hanging wisteria at dusk, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm lantern light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
